Name: Slingshot Bombs
Author: wind0nd
Description:
[size=5][b]Slingshot Bombs[/b][/size]

Turn your slingshot into a long-range demolition tool. Load it with bombs, aim at your target, and send an explosion flying across the map.
[b]Slingshot Bombs[/b] adds charge-based bomb firing, with configurable projectile speed, explosion radius, monster damage, and map interactions. Whether you’re clearing rocks or fighting monsters, you can tune the experience to suit your playstyle.
[heading]Features[/heading]
Fire bombs from your slingshot
Use the following ammunition with the mod’s projectile and explosion mechanics:
[list]
[*]Explosive Ammo[/*]
[*]Cherry Bombs[/*]
[*]Bombs[/*]
[*]Mega Bombs[/*]
[/list]Hold to charge, aim with your mouse, and release to fire. Charging increases projectile speed and applies a higher monster damage multiplier.
Customize your shots
Adjust the settings to make your slingshot feel the way you want:
[list]
[*]Set minimum and full charge times.[/*]
[*]Change the full-charge monster damage multiplier.[/*]
[*]Configure each ammunition type’s base damage, explosion radius, and projectile speed.[/*]
[*]Choose whether projectiles explode on walls, buildings, or monsters.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable slingshot bomb self-damage.[/*]
[*]Optionally snap your aim to the center of a tile.[/*]
[/list]Configure map interactions
Explosions can do more than damage monsters:
[list]
[*]Protect supported facilities and ordinary plants from accidental damage.[/*]
[*]Collect eligible map items as ground drops.[/*]
[*]Enable extra breaking of supported large stone and plant resources.[/*]
[*]Control explosion tilling.[/*]
[/list]These map features can also be enabled for [b]placed bombs[/b]. Placed bombs keep their own explosion radius and damage behavior; the slingshot’s charge and damage settings don’t apply to them.
[quote][b]Note:[/b] Protection and collection depend on how objects are identified. Some vanilla or modded objects may behave differently, and collectible player-placed items may be affected. Test near valuables with care.[/quote][heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Attach a supported bomb or Explosive Ammo to your slingshot.[/*]
[*]Hold the tool-use button to charge.[/*]
[*]Aim with your mouse and release to fire.[/*]
[*]Adjust the settings through Generic Mod Config Menu or 
[code]config.json[/code].[/*]
[/list]The default minimum charge time is [b]0.15 seconds[/b]. Releasing before the minimum charge time won’t consume ammunition.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — optional, for changing settings in-game.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract [b]Slingshot Bombs[/b] into your 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Configure the mod in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu, or edit its 
[code]config.json[/code] after the first launch.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility and Notes[/heading]
[list]
[*]The current version is intended for [b]single-player[/b] and [b]mouse aiming[/b].[/*]
[*]Placed-bomb map features are disabled by default.[/*]
[*]Support for custom resources depends on the other mod’s implementation.[/*]
[*]Back up your save before testing map-altering features, especially when using other mods that add objects or resources.[/*]
[/list]
